_about: The emails this project sends, in one place: which prompts each uses, subjects, footer, who gets it. Read by azure/run.py (the runner) and claude/run.sh (the fallback). Prompt files are in daily-brief/prompts (mail_guide.md is generated from mail_sources.json at deploy; azure_prompts are added on Azure runs only).
footer: _To adjust {what}, reply with one command per line: **skip** thing · **more** thing · **undo** · **show**. For example: “skip ice skating”. Bigger changes are made directly, not by reply._
